lines.text: The desert will blossom like a rose, and the glory of Lebanon will be given to it.
The limp hands and feeble knees are to be strengthened, and anxious hearts are told to be strong and not fear.
The eyes of the blind will be opened, the lame will leap like a lion, and waters will gush in the wilderness.
Where jackals once lay, cedars and cypresses and pines will grow, and a highway called the Way of Holiness will be there.
The redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy.
